title: Move source navigation checks out and retire Dashboard Integrated UI Test

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** For SEED-334#retire-emptied-integrated-ui-test-group at `0f766a96082257ece4e163ec49cda64f74a0aeff`, the maintained Backend case caught a space sent literally in a canonical GitHub contents path. The story promises one read for the selected record at the pinned revision, with its space encoded as `%20`.

The detached scratch fault added `.replaceAll("%20", " ")` after path encoding in `dashboard/server/ghContents.ts`. It left the test and its fixture intact. The case served a backlog linking to `docs/release%20notes/2026.md`, established membership through the real local dashboard server, and read the record at the pinned revision through that server. The faulted run still got HTTP 200 and the expected record body. The controlled GitHub fixture independently recorded one call with `contents/docs/release notes/2026.md?ref=<revision>`. The exact argv comparison at `dashboard/backend-tests/observation/authenticated-read-boundary.spec.ts:203` expected `contents/docs/release%20notes/2026.md?ref=<revision>` and failed on that difference.

`npx playwright test --config dashboard/backend.playwright.config.ts dashboard/backend-tests/observation/authenticated-read-boundary.spec.ts --grep 'encodes the space in a canonical path' --workers=2` selected and executed exactly one case in each phase. On AC power under `caffeinate -s -i`, exit codes were 0 for baseline, 1 for the fault, and 0 after restoration. The restored file checksum and clean Git status matched the baseline both before and after the restored pass. The scratch checkout was removed. Proof records, the fault diff, and the restored state checks are in Git evidence under `intent-coverage-canonical-path.ihwJvq`.

The first harness stopped when ANSI color codes prevented matching the assertion line after the expected failure. Its cleanup restored the file and retired that checkout. Matching the plain-text diagnostic in a new detached checkout completed the sequence.

**Next proof action.** Retain the exact argv assertion in the maintained Backend case. This check confirms the decision already recorded in slice 1 to preserve this proof at the server boundary.

- **Test runtime.** 6.213 s (measured), summing the Playwright runner durations for the complete baseline, fault, and restored runs. The initial harness used another 5.385 s of measured runner time.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. The check had no separately measured human work.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. The host supplied no separate effort measurement for this check.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 207380 ms (measured), from 1795011017401 to 1795011224781 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: checked `0f766a96082257ece4e163ec49cda64f74a0aeff`, Caught, retain the distinguishing Backend assertion, no follow-up.
